trigger_queries.query: What can I order from the service catalog?
Order a 27-inch monitor for Sam Lee
do we have standing desks i can request
my new hire starts monday, can you get her a headset
Find me a wireless keyboard and mouse
Show me the software categories in the catalog
What's the status of my laptop request RITM0010023?
Cancel my order for the monitor
Approve Sam's request for a new phone
My laptop screen is flickering, open a ticket
My payslip is wrong, I need HR to fix it
Add a new item to the catalog for ergonomic chairs
How do I reset my password?
I need an employment verification letter

behavior_cases.prompt: I need a new laptop, the standard developer one.
behavior_cases.expected: The agent finds the orderable item, asks only for missing mandatory answers, confirms every value, orders once for the user and replies with the REQ number.
assertions: Searches with sn__get_catalog_items using text from the request, not sn__list_records on sc_cat_item
Reads the item with sn__get_catalog_item before asking anything
Asks only for mandatory questions without a usable default that the user hasn't answered
Lists the item, quantity, who it's for and every answer, and waits for yes before ordering
Calls sn__order_item once with variables keyed by question name, choice values rather than labels, sysparm_quantity "1" and no sysparm_requested_for
Reads the request back with sn__get_record on sc_request using the returned request_id
Replies in one sentence with the request number

behavior_cases.prompt: Order a 27-inch monitor for Sam Lee on my team.
behavior_cases.expected: The agent finds Sam Lee, sets him as the Requested For answer and sysparm_requested_for, confirms with his name and orders once.
assertions: Calls sn__get_record_schema with table sys_user to find the name and email fields
Searches sys_user with sn__list_records using a LIKE condition on the name field and returns only sys_id, name and email
Checks that the item has a Requested For question (a sys_user reference) before ordering for Sam
Sends Sam's sys_id as the Requested For answer and as sysparm_requested_for in sn__order_item
Names Sam Lee in the confirmation and waits for yes

behavior_cases.expected: The agent walks catalogs and categories, then shows only orderable items in the catalog view with a one-sentence reply.
assertions: Calls sn__get_catalogs, then sn__get_catalog_categories for the chosen catalog
Lists catalog or category names in one line and asks which, instead of dumping every item
Shows items with ux__show_records entity catalog_item, passing only items whose type is catalog_item with sys_class_name sc_cat_item, pc_hardware_cat_item or pc_software_cat_item
Doesn't restate the items listed in the view

behavior_cases.prompt: I want to request a parking permit.
behavior_cases.expected: The only match is a record producer, which no tool here can submit; the agent says it can't be ordered here and points to the service portal.
assertions: Searches with sn__get_catalog_items
Recognises the match as a record_producer (sys_class_name sc_cat_item_producer) and doesn't offer it for ordering
Doesn't call sn__order_item or sn__create_record
Says in one sentence that this item can't be ordered here and to use the service portal

behavior_cases.prompt: Get me Visio. Just go ahead and order it.
behavior_cases.expected: The item's Requested For question defaults to javascript:gs.getUserID(); the agent sends the user's sys_id instead of the script and still asks for any missing mandatory answer before ordering.
assertions: Calls sn__get_current_user_info and uses the user's sys_id for the Requested For answer
Never sends the text javascript:gs.getUserID() as a variable value
Asks for any mandatory answer still missing before calling sn__order_item
Calls sn__order_item only once

behavior_cases.prompt: Cancel my request REQ0010045, I don't need the monitor any more.
behavior_cases.expected: Cancelling an existing order isn't supported here; the agent says so in one sentence and changes nothing.
assertions: Doesn't call sn__update_record, sn__order_item or any other write
Says it can only browse and place new orders here
